newsitem.title: CHINA: Chiwan Wharf H1 cargo traffic triples.
newsitem.headline: Chiwan Wharf H1 cargo traffic triples.

text.p: The volume of cargo handled by China's Chiwan Wharf Holdings Ltd rose a year-on-year 280.52 percent in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.
The newspaper did not give exact figures or a forecast of profits. Company officials declined comment.
Chiwan has said it handled 23,983 Twenty-Foot Equivalent Units (TEU) of cargo in the first six months of 1996.
In the same 1996 period, it posted net profits of 56 million yuan. Chiwan did not say what accounting standards the figure was based on.
